clue.text: Sheepish labourer, first to bathe in the sea at Calais

first letter of the word bathe

explanation.surface: A shy farmhand is the first of his group to go swimming in the Channel off Calais.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' takes the opening letter of 'bathe', which then sits inside LA MER.
explanation.definitionFit: A lamber is a farm worker who tends ewes at lambing time, so his labour is literally sheep-related.

clue.text: Perhaps catch nothing, upset about cricket practice

explanation.definitionFit: A catch on a door or bag is one example of a device that fastens things, hence 'Perhaps'.

explanation.walkthrough: Both Es come out of 'file they', one from each word, leaving FILTHY.
